# Run book: Render a panel from a server-supplied definition

[Run books](README.md) | [User guide](../user-guide/server-driven-ui.md) | [Spec](../specs/server-driven-ui.md)

## Purpose

See the framework UI contract rendered by a client that has no knowledge of the form.

## Preconditions

- The example API is running.

## Verify

Automatically: `npx playwright test e2e/journeys.spec.ts -g "Render a panel from a server-supplied definition"` (add `E2E_BASE_URL=http://localhost:8088` to run against the compose stack).

By hand, in the example web application at `/utilities/server-ui`:

1. **Open the definition.** Pick the bench supply. The page fetches the definition and asks the host for each control state. Expect: The Output section shows with Voltage disabled and its reason.
2. **Enable the output and enter a bad value.** Switching the output on enables Voltage. A value above 30 is rejected by the host. Expect: Voltage accepts input and shows a range error.
3. **Switch mode to reveal a section.** Choosing Constant current makes the Current limit section visible. Expect: The Current limit section appears with a Reset limit button.

## Troubleshooting

**Table 1 — Known problems**

| Symptom | Likely cause | Fix |
| --- | --- | --- |
| The Voltage field is disabled | Its enabled-when condition is not met | Switch the output on |
| A red message appears under a field | The value broke the control constraint | Enter a value in the stated range |

Related framework features: OoBDev.UiDefinitions (`UiDefinition`, `ValueValidator`, `FormDefinitionGenerator`).
